title: Alive World
description: A port of Presence Not Required to Fabric 1.18.2
body:
This is a port of [Presence Not Reuired](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/presence-not-required) to Fabric 1.18.2, made by [javivi09dev](https://github.com/javivi09dev) for use in my modpack [Eerie](https://modrinth.com/modpack/eerie). For a more detailed explanation, please go to the original mod's description.

I don't plan to update this mod, but it is open source

This mod takes blocks and animals from when chunks are loaded in and updates them as if the chunk has always been loaded. This implements all the functionality of Presence Not Required, including:
- Crop / plant growth
- Furnaces, brewing stands, and campfire progress
- Animal growth
